item.title: Artemis II lifts off on historic crewed mission around the Moon - Kouga News
item.description: NASA’s Artemis II mission lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Wednesday, 1 April 2026, sending four astronauts on an approximately 10-day mission around the Moon and back to Earth. The launch marks the first crewed flight of NASA’s Artemis programme and the first crewed lunar flyby mission in more than 50 years.

item.title: More than 2,200 SANDF members deployed to assist SAPS over Easter weekend - Kouga News
item.description: Government says more than 2,200 South African National Defence Force members have been deployed to assist the South African Police Service in crime-fighting efforts over the Easter weekend. The deployment covers the Western Cape, Gauteng, Eastern Cape, Free State and North West as part of a broader safety effort.

item.title: A Message to Our Christian Readers - Kouga News
item.description: In the busy coastal towns and beautiful communities of the Kouga region, from Jeffreys Bay to Humansdorp, St Francis Bay to Patensie, may this Easter season bring you fresh hope and renewed faith.

item.title: Five Top Things to Do in Kouga This Easter Weekend - Kouga News
item.description: Whether you choose the lively beach scene and sandboarding thrills of Jeffreys Bay or the serene canals and lighthouse views of St Francis Bay, Kouga delivers a memorable and varied Easter escape.

item.title: Bombela Concession Company SA National Swimming Championships set for Gqeberha - Kouga News
item.description: Gqeberha will host the Bombela Concession Company SA National Swimming Championships at Newton Park Swimming Pool from 14 to 18 April 2026. The five-day programme includes national swimming events as well as para swimming events, with daily heats from 09:30 and finals from 17:00.

item.title: South Africa’s Luke Thompson advances at Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach - Kouga News
item.description: South African surfer Luke Thompson made a strong start to his 2026 World Surf League Championship Tour campaign by advancing from Heat 3 at the Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach Presented by Bonsoy in Victoria, Australia. Thompson moved through with a 14.67 total, defeating Ramzi Boukhiam of Morocco on the opening day of competition.

item.title: Daisies chase fourth straight title as Dames target first crown in Women’s Super League final - Kouga News
item.description: The Bulls Daisies will host the Boland Dames in the 2026 Pick n Pay Women’s Super League final at Loftus Versfeld on Saturday, 4 April. The Daisies are chasing a fourth consecutive title, while the Dames will be aiming to lift the Premier Division trophy for the first time.

item.title: SAPS Suspends Captain Over Alleged Multi Million Rand Fraud - Kouga News
item.description: Further investigation revealed that the intended recipients, the close protectors, never received the funds. Instead, the money was withdrawn in lump sum cash payments by the captain himself.

item.title: Nico Malan hosts Australian school side in Humansdorp rugby friendly today - Kouga News
item.description: Nico Malan is welcoming All Saints Anglican School from Australia to Humansdorp today, Saturday, 4 April 2026, for an international friendly rugby fixture. The match sees Nico Malan’s Sterre (3rd XV) take on the visitors’ 1st XV in a morning clash celebrating international friendship.
